prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1305; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you please state where you were when the collision happened?

A: Sure. I was driving through an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, heading east on the main road when it happened.

Q: Okay. Can you describe the traffic signal for your direction?

A: My light was green. I'm pretty sure of that because I had just come off a stop at the previous block and it turned green as I approached.

Q: And what happened next?

A: A pickup coming from the cross street to my right ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car. The impact spun me a bit and pushed me toward the curb.

Q: Did you see the pickup before the impact?

A: Only for a second. I saw headlights come into the corner of my view and then heard the brakes, but there wasn't time to do anything.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: I was sore in my neck and right shoulder right away, but I didn't think it was serious at first. The shoulder got worse over the next day or two. I've been having trouble lifting my arm above my head and sleeping on that side.

Q: Have you seen a doctor for the shoulder?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the following day and I've since been referred for physical therapy. I'm still going through that.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add about the collision?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I believe the other driver simply didn't stop. I'm hoping the report reflects that.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your time. We'll follow up with you soon.
